body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a visual completeness QA gate script for Wave 1 crop artifacts, along with its unit tests and generated artifacts, including fixtures, readback, and validator results. The reviewer's feedback focuses on ensuring deterministic, locale-independent output to prevent diff churn. Specifically, the reviewer recommends implementing a strict byte-order sorting helper to lexicographically sort generated JSON arrays (such as manifest rows, validator checks, fixture cases, and artifact receipts) by their respective ID fields, replacing `localeCompare` with strict byte-order comparison, and updating unit tests to assert that validator checks are correctly sorted and passing.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
